name: St. Regis Shanghai Jingan
positioning: The St. Regis Shanghai Jingan: a downtown hotel on West Beijing Road in Jing'an District, with interiors blending English and Chinese palatial styles
best_for: Travelers who want a central Jing'an base near West Nanjing Road subway station
Guests who enjoy afternoon tea, cocktail bars and varied on-site dining

facts.text: The hotel is on West Beijing Road in the heart of Jing'an District, Shanghai's cultural and business center.
The nearest subway station is West Nanjing Road.
The closest airport is Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport, about 16.2 kilometers away.
The St. Regis Bar pays homage to the King Cole Bar and serves premium whiskeys, fine wines, rare spirits, champagnes and handcrafted cocktails.
Bespoke is a steakhouse with a view of West Beijing Road, serving premium steaks and fine wines.
Yan Ting is the hotel's Chinese restaurant, with contemporary and classic Chinese decor.
The St. Regis Patisserie offers freshly baked breads, desserts, handmade chocolates and customized cakes made by the hotel's Western pastry team.
The St. Regis Spa and Fitness Center offer specialty massages, a 24-hour fitness center, a sauna, a steam room and a yoga room.
The hotel has a heated indoor pool with a lifeguard on duty.
The Premier Deluxe room is a corner room with a city view and an oversized bathroom.
The St. Regis Suite is a one-bedroom suite with a guest powder room.
The Astor Ballroom includes a 90-square-meter LED wall projection system.

highlights.text: The hotel's public spaces showcase five glass sculptures by artist Dale Chihuly.
The interiors blend traditional English and Chinese palatial styles with elements of Chinese art such as calligraphy and handcrafted gold foil paintings.
The Drawing Room in the lobby serves a modern interpretation of Afternoon Tea every afternoon, celebrating Caroline Astor's legacy.
The Manor, the executive lounge, is on the 55th floor with panoramic views over Jing'an District and downtown Shanghai.
Seki-tei is a Japanese restaurant with four private rooms.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle; a hotel limousine can be reserved for a fee.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the premium positioning.
